purpose: Define current versus legacy mod system rules so future mod and suffix modules can support current-only, legacy-only, and hybrid inventory modes without merging distinct records.
optimizerRules: Never recommend legacy_retained_only mods in current_only mode.
Allow legacy_retained_only mods in legacy_only mode.
Allow both current and legacy mods in hybrid_inventory mode.
If availability is unknown, do not recommend as best-in-slot by default.
If systemVersion is unknown, flag the row for review.
If a current and legacy mod share a similar name but have different effects, treat them as separate records.
Never merge legacy and current effects into one record.
Every future mod or suffix record must preserve original source values and normalized English values separately.
Every future mod or suffix record must include systemVersion and availability metadata.
notes: This registry only defines policy and metadata rules for future mod and suffix modules.
No actual mod or suffix data is imported here.
